$description: Spacing, radius, size and breakpoint values as shipped, copied from the style-guide artifact on 2026-11-03. Source data: do not edit.
source: MNG Android Style Guide artifact (https://claude.ai/artifact/5MyLP13QSt52WGRgXW35ZJ), android-tribpub @ 1cfb069a6, project/tokens.json

spacing.note: No shared spacing scale exists. These are the values the code uses, each with its source.

tokens.name: space-cell-padding
tokens.usage: Section-front cell padding, phone and tablet (sections dimens.xml:22, cell_padding).

tokens.name: space-cell-spacing
tokens.usage: Spacing between elements in a section-front cell (sections dimens.xml:23, cell_spacing).

tokens.name: space-article-side
tokens.usage: Article side padding, phone portrait (articles values/dimens.xml:44, native_article_side_padding).

tokens.name: space-article-side-land
tokens.usage: Article side padding in landscape (values-land).

tokens.name: space-article-side-tablet
tokens.usage: Article side padding at sw600dp and up (values-sw600dp, -sw720dp).

tokens.name: space-login-margin
tokens.usage: Side margins of paywall login buttons (LoginButtonStyle).

tokens.name: radius-paywall
tokens.usage: Paywall Subscribe button and subscription options have no corner radius (plain color background).

tokens.name: radius-whatsnew
tokens.usage: What's New Continue button (btn_rounded_corner.xml); outlined sheet buttons (btn_outlined_bg).

tokens.name: radius-continue
tokens.usage: Your News Continue button (bg_continue.xml).

tokens.name: radius-sheet-button
tokens.usage: Manage subscription and delete account buttons (manage_app_sub_button_corner_radius, delete_account_buttons_corner).

tokens.name: radius-discount
tokens.usage: Savings label on the subscription screen (paywall_discount_rounded_label.xml).

tokens.name: size-touch-min
tokens.usage: Android's recommended minimum touch target. Not enforced app-wide; only the settings button uses 48dp (action_button_min_width).

tokens.name: size-nav-icon
tokens.usage: Bottom-nav icon height (bottom_navigation_icon_height).

tokens.name: size-player-control
tokens.usage: Persistent audio player play/pause and close (activity_articles.xml). Below size-touch-min.

tokens.name: size-author-icon
tokens.usage: Author contact icons (fragment_author.xml). Below size-touch-min.

tokens.name: size-overlay-close
tokens.usage: Breaking-news and live-video overlay close buttons. Below size-touch-min.

tokens.name: size-paywall-button
tokens.usage: Paywall Subscribe button height (paywall_button_height).

breakpoint.note: Section fronts pick a width class from the physical screen width in inches (AppConfig.kt:116-138), not dp. Resource qualifiers use dp.

tokens.name: bp-xsmall
tokens.usage: XSMALL below 4.1 inches wide (config.json screenSizeConfigs).

tokens.name: bp-small
tokens.usage: SMALL below 6.1 inches.

tokens.name: bp-medium
tokens.usage: MEDIUM below 7.8 inches.

tokens.name: bp-large
tokens.usage: LARGE below 10.4 inches; XLARGE above.

tokens.name: bp-tablet-config
tokens.usage: sw500dp loads the tablet remote config and is_phone=false (ads: 728x90 first slot).

tokens.name: bp-tablet-res
tokens.usage: sw600dp switches article padding to 75dp and larger article type.

tokens.name: grid-columns
tokens.usage: Section-front items take widths out of 12 per width class (ModelHelper.kt:15).
